options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Default timeout to wait for transaction to finish in seconds.

options.name: append
options.description: Do not overwrite the whole object but instead append the defined properties. Note - Appending to existing vars, imports or any other list/dict is not possible. You have to overwrite the complete list/dict. Note - Variables that are set by default will also be applied, even if not set.

options.name: check_command
options.description: Check command definition.

options.name: check_interval
options.description: Your regular check interval.

options.name: check_period
options.description: The name of a time period which determines when this object should be monitored. Not limited by default.

options.name: check_timeout
options.description: Check command timeout in seconds. Overrides the CheckCommand's timeout attribute.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication. This file can also include the key as well, and if the key is included, O(client_key) is not required.

options.name: client_key
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication. If O(client_cert) contains both the certificate and key, this option is not required.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disabled objects will not be deployed.

options.name: display_name
options.description: Alternative name for this service.

options.name: enable_active_checks
options.description: Whether to actively check this object.

options.name: enable_event_handler
options.description: Whether to enable event handlers this object.

options.name: enable_flapping
options.description: Whether flap detection is enabled on this object.

options.name: enable_notifications
options.description: Whether to send notifications for this object.

options.name: enable_passive_checks
options.description: Whether to accept passive check results for this object.

options.name: enable_perfdata
options.description: Whether to process performance data provided by this object.

options.name: event_command
options.description: Event command for service which gets called on every check execution if one of these conditions matches The service is in a soft state The service state changes into a hard state The service state recovers from a soft or hard state to OK/Up

options.name: flapping_threshold_high
options.description: Flapping upper bound in percent for a service to be considered flapping

options.name: flapping_threshold_low
options.description: Flapping lower bound in percent for a service to be considered not flapping

options.name: force
options.description: If V(yes) do not get a cached copy.

options.name: force_basic_auth
options.description: Credentials specified with O(url_username) and O(url_password) should be passed in HTTP Header.

options.name: groups
options.description: Service groups that should be directly assigned to this service. Servicegroups can be useful for various reasons. They are helpful to provided service-type specific view in Icinga Web 2, either for custom dashboards or as an instrument to enforce restrictions. Service groups can be directly assigned to single services or to service templates.

options.name: host
options.description: Choose the host this single service should be assigned to. This field will be required when `service_set` is not defined.

options.name: http_agent
options.description: Header to identify as, generally appears in web server logs.

options.name: icon_image
options.description: An URL pointing to an icon for this object. Try "tux.png" for icons relative to public/img/icons or "cloud" (no extension) for items from the Icinga icon font

options.name: icon_image_alt
options.description: Alternative text to be shown in case above icon is missing

options.name: imports
options.description: Importable templates, add as many as you want. Please note that order matters when importing properties from multiple templates - last one wins.

options.name: max_check_attempts
options.description: Defines after how many check attempts a new hard state is reached.

options.name: notes
options.description: Additional notes for this object.

options.name: notes_url
options.description: An URL pointing to additional notes for this object. Separate multiple urls like this "'http://url1' 'http://url2'". Maximum length is 255 characters.

options.name: object_name
options.description: Name of the service.

options.name: retry_interval
options.description: Retry interval, will be applied after a state change unless the next hard state is reached.

options.name: service_set
options.description: Choose the service set name this single service should be assigned to. This field will be required when `host` is not defined.

options.name: state
options.description: Apply feature state.

options.name: url
options.description: HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP URL in the form (http|https|ftp)://[user[:pass]]@host.domain[:port]/path

options.name: url_password
options.description: The password for use in HTTP basic authentication. If the O(url_username) parameter is not specified, the O(url_password) parameter will not be used.

options.name: url_username
options.description: The username for use in HTTP basic authentication. This parameter can be used without O(url_password) for sites that allow empty passwords.

options.name: use_agent
options.description: Whether the check command for this service should be executed on the Icinga agent.

options.name: use_gssapi
options.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library L(gssapi,https://github.com/pythongssapi/python-gssapi) to be installed. Credentials for GSSAPI can be specified with O(url_username)/O(url_password) or with the GSSAPI env var E(KRB5CCNAME) that specified a custom Kerberos credential cache. NTLM authentication is B(not) supported even if the GSSAPI mech for NTLM has been installed.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If V(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vars
options.description: Custom properties of the service.

options.name: volatile
options.description: Whether this check is volatile.
